comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body:
Three harnesses vs one undisclosed Claude model?

This seems like a weird comparison to drive here. First off, the best model available on Lovable is Claude Opus. Pixelmake is Gemini driven, and Figma is Gemini or GPT. So to get the best lovable result, you'd have to use claude, but your claude result is terrible and looks more like Haiku or something. This seems like a marketing stunt. Why not compare actual models if you wanted to drive a real comparison rather than snake oil middle-men who simply upcharge on a service and provide a worse harness than what you could find for free?
